name: Colored Gaze
source:
A college student by day and works at night at the local convenience store. You meet some interesting individuals each night but be careful.. they might not be what they seem to appear and its up to you to find out what their true colors are.

[From [url=https://mrritz.itch.io/clrdgazevn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你白天是大学生，晚上则在当地便利店打工。每天晚上你都会遇到一些有趣的人，但要当心……他们或许并不像表面看起来那样，只有你能揭开他们真实的一面。

[摘自[url=https://mrritz.itch.io/clrdgazevn]Itch.io[/url]]
